_comment: QQQ SWING sleeve, v2 = 'base + trade around it' oscillator (always net long), with a Z-BANDED EXPOSURE LADDER so the step size scales with the size of the weekly move: aggressive on big dips/rips, gentle (or nothing) on small ones. Holds a permanent BASE long (base_pct of the swing budget, a protected floor NEVER sold). The other (1-base_pct) trades AROUND it, split into n_steps equal steps. add_ladder/trim_ladder map the weekly-to-date z to a TARGET number of deployed steps: on the dip side deeper z -> higher target (buy more); on the rip side higher z -> lower target (sell more). The gap between +/-1sigma and 0 is a DEAD-BAND where small moves do nothing. A big move jumps straight to a further target => several steps in ONE order; a small move moves one step. cooldown_days gates add/trim (not the base). long_only. 'capital' is a fallback; live sizing uses allocation.py swing_budget (swing_pct of real account value). Deployed ranges base_pct*budget (0 steps) up to full budget (n_steps).
